rules: Always run `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` before pushing
Use thiserror for error types, never unwrap() in production code
Each task = one commit. Commit message format: type: description (closes #N)
Do NOT add dependencies without discussion
Do NOT add features outside the current phase
Prefer &str over String in function signatures where possible
Use Arc<dyn Trait> for shared state, not global statics
